notes.title: Update 0.27.431
notes.content:
We're excited to introduce update 0.27.431 for our game (still in the prototyping stage). This patch brings new mechanics, gameplay improvements, and various bug fixes.

[h2]Full Changelog[/h2]
[h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Match countdown timer (currently in debug mode).
[*] Basic framework for simplified AI.
[*] Camera fade-out effect on death.
[*] Bone fractures from gunshots.
[/list]

[h3]Fixed:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Visual effect positioning when shooting.
[*] Bug that canceled shooting when switching weapons.
[*] Character death logic.
[*] Various UI bugs, improving interface stability.
[*] Some inventory-related bugs.
[*] Damage calculation logic.
[/list]

[h3]Restored:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Weapon slot switching in inventory – you can now change slots again.
[*] Shooting system.
[*] Character leaning.
[*] HP display scheme.
[/list]

[h3]Technical Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] AI refactor in preparation for behavior improvements.
[*] Animation blueprint refactor.
[*] Character ability refactor.
[*] Removal of old project codebase to prepare for future updates.
[/list]

Thank you for your support and valuable feedback! We're working hard to make the game better! 🚀

notes.title: Update 0.25.405
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, everyone![/h1]

We’re excited to share a long-awaited update about the project! 🎉

[h2]Current Status:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The project is alive and in active development.
[*] Unfortunately, updates are posted less frequently because I'm working on the project solo. Thank you for your patience and support! 💪
[/list]

[h2]Outdated Info:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [u][b]Old trailers and screenshots no longer reflect the current state of the project, so please keep that in mind.[/b][/u]
[/list]

[h2]What’s Done:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The character system has been upgraded to version 5, making the skeleton, visuals, and animations more realistic and fully compatible with modern technologies and systems.
[*] A basic character editor has been added. You’re no longer stuck with presets; you can now customize your character’s appearance. While the options are limited for now, it’s close to being a fully-fledged editor.
[*] Movement mechanics have been completely revamped.
[*] The logic for the starting map and menu has been overhauled.
[*] Fixed issues with saving game settings.
[/list]

[h2]What’s in Progress:[/h2]
[list]
[*] A complete refactor of the weapon system, including a core replacement.
[*] Gradual deployment of a more complex backend architecture.
[/list]

[h2]What’s Coming Next:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improvements to the inventory, hotbar, and UI.
[*] Replacement of the old melee combat system.
[*] Addition of a weapon crafting workbench.
[*] Preparation of the core game mode.
[*] Parallel development of related systems.
[/list]

Thank you for sticking with the project. Your support keeps me motivated to push forward! ❤️
PS: and that's not all that's been done here..

notes.title: Update 0.18.319
notes.content:
We present to you update 0.18.319 for the game (still in the prototyping stage). This update includes hit effects when shooting, improved gameplay, and fixes for several bugs.

[h2]Full list of changes[/h2]
[h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dropping the active weapon from hands upon character death
[*] Sounds from shell casings
[*] Bullet hit effects on static objects
[/list]

[h3]Fixed:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bug with remaining weapon when a player exits a raid
[*] Status in the widget after exiting a raid
[*] Logic for ricochet
[*] Ejection of shell casings after firing
[*] Shooting from holstered weapons
[/list]

[h3]Restored:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Switching fire modes
[/list]

[h3]Technical changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Refactoring and removal of old project code base
[/list]

Thank you for your support and valuable feedback! We strive to make the game better!
